archive_production.archive_need_not_be_archived: the tar is byte-reproducible from the source commit with the pinned invocation, proven by the double build. The commit plus this record is the durable artifact; the 8.7 MB tar is regenerable bulk and is not committed to Git (ADR 0050).
archive_production.determinism: two independent builds produced the identical archive SHA-256 and the identical candidate aggregate.
archive_production.\u26d4 both_flags_are_mandatory: git archive is a CHECKOUT-faithful exporter, not a blob-faithful one: it applies CRLF on export to every file lacking an explicit eol=lf gitattribute. core.eol=lf ALONE is a SILENT NO-OP because core.autocrlf=true overrides it - last time it produced a byte-identical archive, i.e. a fix that looked applied. Both flags, always.
